decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith # K/20/B S - 1, S - 2, S - 3, S - 4, S - 5 (received 06/09/2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The outbuilding shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the use of the main house.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension, partial demolition of front of garage, extension to rear of garage and conversion of garage to habitable room.
